title: Grilled Bean Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make vegetarian dish perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. Marinate the beans in a mixture of unctuous Egyptian spices and grill them to perfection.

ingredients.name: Egyptian spice blend
ingredients.notes: can be found in most supermarkets or online

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: Soak the wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Egyptian spice blend, and red wine vinegar (if using).
Add the red kidney beans to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beans onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each bean.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beans are tender and lightly charred.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
